prompt: I just got a verbal offer for 150k base plus 50k equity. My current total comp is 180k. Should I accept on this call?
expected: Refuse on-call acceptance; ask for written package details and ~48 hours; compute annualized total comp; ask for market band before any stay/accept number; counter formula 2×target−offer when ready.
actual: Told the user not to accept on the call. Asked for written base/bonus/equity/sign-on details and ~48 hours. Computed that 150k+50k needs risk-adjusted total-comp math against 180k current. Refused a yes/no until market band and live alternatives were known; prepared a 2×target−offer counter once band exists.

prompt: I want to pivot from frontend engineer to product manager in healthcare at the same time. What should I do first?
expected: Apply one-variable transitions (Rule 4); advise changing role OR industry first; explain leverage/comp/title cost of two simultaneous resets; optionally point to references/pivots.md.
actual: Invoked Rule 4 one-variable transitions. Recommended either PM in the current industry first, or healthcare as a frontend engineer first. Explained that two simultaneous changes reset leverage on both axes and typically costs title and comp. Pointed to references/pivots.md for sequencing.

prompt: Can you rewrite my resume bullets for a staff engineer role and then tell me whether I should quit?
expected: Route resume rewriting to `resume`; keep career skill on stay/leave only after BATNA/comp/band facts; do not silently merge both jobs into one answer.
actual: Handed resume bullet rewriting to `resume`. Kept career scope on the quit decision and required current total comp, market band, and a live alternative before any stay/leave recommendation (Rule 1 / Decision Razor).
